title: Software Engineering Technical Leader - Hardware Diagnostic Engineer
locations: San Jose, California, United States of America
teaser: Exciting opportunity for a Hardware Diagnostic Engineer to develop diagnostics test suites for Cisco switches on Linux servers. Lead hardware system bring-up and collaborate with multi-functional teams to resolve complex hardware issues. Ideal for experienced engineers with strong embedded software and hardware development expertise.

Meet the Team

The Common Hardware Group (CHG) creates innovative hardware platforms central to the AI era, powering Cisco’s core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products for organizations globally. Our innovations in silicon, optics, and hardware platforms—like Silicon One—are shaping the technology industry. We're a global team of creative experts, bringing our unique backgrounds and bold ideas to push boundaries and help each other grow. Because full product development—from design to qualification to production—is within our team, we’re able to think differently, experiment more, and work quickly. Join us to power the future of the digital world!

Your Impact

Be part of the Cisco Common Hardware Group's QUAD (Quality and Diagnostics) team! This team works on Hyperscale network and Enterprise Data Center switches based on Cisco Silicon One ASIC. This is a unique opportunity to grow your technical skills and will allow for visibility and recognition across multi-functional teams within Cisco. We value motivated individuals who enjoy solving complex challenges and thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment.

In this role as Hardware Diagnostic Engineer, you will develop the diagnostics tests suites for cisco switches on Linux server using your embedded software development skills. You will work on new hardware system bring-up, collaborate with multi-functional teams including ASIC team, hardware team, vendors, and manufacturers to tackle complicated hardware issues and develop board support package (BSP) for ASIC bringing up and running SONiC. You will also support our manufacturing test team for failure analysis to improve product yield and shorten the test time. 

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with at least 8+ years of professional experience, or a Master’s degree with at least 6+ years of professional experience.

Minimum of 5 years of professional experience developing software using C/C++ and/or Python within a Linux environment.

Minimum of 5 years of experience in hardware-level programming and device driver development.

Demonstrated expertise in Linux hardware bring-up and system integration.

Proven experience working with microcontrollers and embedded peripherals including: I2C, PCIe, SPI, and MDIO.

Preferred Qualifications

Linux kernel device driver development experience.

Understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 network protocols and technologies such as TCP/IP.

Experience with Networking ASICs and PHY testing.

Experience with testing SSD, USB, NVRAM, or eMMC.

Experience with troubleshooting and debugging skills. 

Familiarity with secure-boot, open-source tools, CMIS, and SFF standards (SFP, QSFP). 

Experience with software quality processes.

Experience supporting mass production test.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
